text.description_html:
Weslock 6661/6402, Oval Stanford Double Cylinder Handleset

There is something to be said for traditional beauty; and the oval mounts of this Weslock made Double Cylinder Handleset paired with the delicate curved handle will not disappoint those looking for a classic that can withstand the ever changing fashions of today's world with undeniable elegance. Available in satin nickel and oil rubbed bronze finishes. Easy to install, the Traditional Stanford Double Cylinder Handleset will fit door thicknesses from 1-3/4 inches to 2 inches. It will adjust to fit doors with backsets of 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. A double cylinder handleset, the deadbolt is operated by a key from both the exterior and the interior; while the latchbolt underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior. Double cylinder entrysets are most often used on doors located near windows. An ANSI rated grade 2 lock, this outside trim handleset made by Weslock not only looks fantastic, it is made with the attention to quality Weslock is known for.

Double Cylinder Handleset: The deadbolt is key operated from both the interior and the exterior while the latch underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior.

Also available matching:
Stanford Single Cylinder Handleset
Stanford Dummy Handleset

This traditionally styled handleset is from the Weslock Elegance Collection which features lifetime finish and mechanical warranties.

Features of the Weslock Traditional Oval Stanford Double Cylinder Handleset:

  • Material: solid brass
  • Meets ANSI A 156.2 grade 2 lock standards.
  • 5-pin cylinder.
  • Adjustable latches with removable faceplates.
  • 1 inch throw deadbolt with two hardened steel rollers to prevent sawing.
  • Fits standard doors preparations with 2-1/8" (1-5/8" optional) top and 2-1/8" bottom cross holes and 1" edge hole and a 5-1/2" center to center cross hole spacing.
  • Manufacturer Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Manufacturer Limited 10 Year Finish Warranty

Specifications of the Elegance Collection Oval Stanford Double Cylinder Handleset:

  • Exterior Length: 18-1/2"
  • Exterior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Exterior Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Length: 10-1/2"
  • Interior Width: 2-5/16"
  • Interior Projection: 2-5/16"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/4" to 2"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplates.

The inside trim will match the handleset's finish.
